home.noPeople: First add the person you want to remind.

start.title: Set up your family
start.intro: Create a family for the people you look after, or join one with a code from a relative.
start.joinIntro: Ask a family editor for an invite code.

members.title: Our family
members.intro: Each person gets their own medicines, routine and voice language.
members.noPeople: No one yet. Add the first person you want to remind.
members.leaveConfirm: Leave this family? You will stop getting alerts.
members.inviteHelp: They create an account in this app, choose “Join a family”, and type this code.
members.note: Family members join with a code. They get alerts on their own phone. Only people you allow can change medicines.

person.name: Name
person.nameHint: What the voice calls them, for example Thatha or Amma.
person.voiceHint: The alarm speaks in this language. It can be different from your app language.
person.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Their phone will be unlinked.
person.viewerNote: Only family editors can change this.
person.phoneHint: For the Call button when a dose is missed.
person.familyPhoneHint: Shown as “Call family” on their phone.
person.periodTrackingHint: Estimate the next date and remind her by voice a few days before. Not medical advice.

setup.title: Set up {{name}}’s phone
setup.intro: Do this once, holding their phone. After that the alarm rings by itself, even when the phone is locked.
setup.step1Title: Install the app and join the family
setup.step1Hint: Type the family code on their phone.
setup.step2Hint: So the reminder can appear on the screen.
setup.step3Hint: Needed so the 7:00 alarm is not late.
setup.step4Hint: So the big alarm opens without unlocking.
setup.step5Title: Turn off battery saving for this app
setup.step5Hint: Stops the phone from closing the app at night.
setup.tapHint: Tap a step to tick it off. On some phones (Xiaomi, Samsung, Oppo, Vivo) the battery step is the one that matters most.
setup.codeHelp: On their phone, open {{url}} and type this code.
setup.unlinkConfirm: Unlink this phone? It will stop getting reminders.

elder.pairIntro: Type the family code from the family app.
elder.noPeople: No one has been added yet. Add a person in the family app first.
elder.offline: No internet. Showing the saved list; alarms still ring.

medicine.name: Medicine name
medicine.voiceLanguageNote: This changes the voice for all of {{name}}’s reminders.
medicine.noVoice: This device has no {{language}} voice to play the preview. Their phone is checked when you set it up.
medicine.notesHint: For example: 1 tablet. Shown to the family.

voice.periodSentence: {{person}}, your period is expected in a few days.

alarm.familyLater: The family will be told when the phone is online

elderSetup.title: Set up this phone
elderSetup.intro: Allow each step so the alarm rings on time, even when the phone is locked.
elderSetup.battery: No battery saving for this app
elderSetup.autostartHint: On {{maker}} phones, also allow this app to start by itself:
elderSetup.voiceMissing: Install the {{language}} voice so the alarm can speak.
elderSetup.noEngine: This phone has no text-to-speech. Install “Speech Services by Google” from the Play Store.
elderSetup.testAlarm: Ring a test alarm in 10 seconds
elderSetup.testHint: Then lock the phone. The alarm should ring, show over the lock screen and speak.
elderSetup.testScheduled: Test alarm set. Lock the phone now and wait 10 seconds.
elderSetup.onlyAndroid: These checks work in the Android app on their phone.

missed.heading: {{name}} has not taken the {{time}} medicine
missed.noPhone: Add {{name}}’s phone number to call from here.
missed.replayNoPush: Push messages are not set up yet, so the phone cannot be rung from here. Please call.
missed.replayNoPhone: {{name}}’s phone cannot be reached. Please call.
missed.footer: Alerts go to everyone in the family group.

alerts.title: Get missed-dose alerts on this device
alerts.body: We will send an alert here if a dose is missed, even when this app is closed.
alerts.iosHint: On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Open the app from the Home Screen and turn on alerts there.
alerts.blocked: Alerts are blocked for this site. Allow notifications in the browser settings.

routine.title: Daily routine
routine.footer: Routine reminders ring on their phone like medicine alarms, but calmer. Dates are estimates and not medical advice.
routine.label: What it is (for the family)
routine.spokenHint: If empty, the voice reads what it is.
routine.exampleText: time to drink a glass of water

period.noDates: Record the first day of the last period to see the next expected date.
period.disclaimer: Dates are estimates and not medical advice.
